map.病虫害用药间隔参考 使用指南: Pesticide Application Interval Reference User Guide
map.查询 12 种常见病虫害的推荐药剂、两次施药的最小间隔与安全采收期，提醒科学用药: Queries the recommended agents for 12 common pests and diseases, the minimum interval between two applications and the pre-harvest period, promoting scientific use to avoid residues and phytotoxicity, for garden and orchard management.
map.虫害条目与要点：蚜虫（吡虫啉/啶虫脒，间隔 7-10 天，最多 3 次/季，安全: Pest entries and key points: aphids (imidacloprid/acetamiprid, 7-10 days, up to 3 times per season, 7-day pre-harvest, spray evenly on both leaf surfaces and concentrate on the insects); spider mites (abamectin/spirotetramat, 5-7 days, 3 times, 14 days, needs at least 2 consecutive applications alternating ovicides and miticides); whitefly (thiamethoxam/bifenthrin, 7-10 days, 3 times, 7 days, apply early morning and late evening together with yellow traps); snails and slugs (metaldehyde, 7 days, 2 times, 7 days, scatter around plant bases in the evening).
map.病害条目与要点：白粉病（三唑酮/苯醚甲环唑，7-10 天，3 次，14 天，发病: Disease entries and key points: powdery mildew (triadimefon/tebuconazole, 7-10 days, 3 times, 14 days, start at first symptoms, alternate systemic and protectant products); black spot disease (mancozeb/carbendazim, 7-10 days, 4 times, 14 days, prevention first, start spraying before the rainy season); gray mold (cyprodinil/fludioxonil, 7 days, 3 times, 14 days, keep ventilation and humidity down and remove diseased leaves and flowers promptly); rust (triadimefon/tebuconazole, 10-14 days, 3 times, 14 days); anthracnose (prochloraz/tebuconazole, 7-10 days, 3 times, 14 days); root rot (oxadixyl/thiophanate-methyl, 10 days, 2 times, 21 days).
map.抗性与安全管理：间隔长、次数多、安全期长的条目标为黄色或橙色警示（介壳虫 噻嗪酮: Resistance and safety management: entries with long intervals, many applications and long safety periods are flagged yellow or orange (scale insects thiamethoxam/chlorpyrifos 10-14 days, 2 times, 21 days; ants and underground pests phorate/chlorpyrifos 14 days, 2 times, 21 days). Using the same mode of action continuously selects for resistant populations, so once you hit the per-season maximum, switch to a different mode of action, and always meet the pre-harvest interval before harvest.
map.操作示例：12 条对照卡片的三看读法: Worked example: a three-pass reading of 12 comparison cards
map.：页面共 12 条病虫害参考，每张卡片按「推荐药剂 → 施药间隔 → 最多施药次: The page lists 12 pest and disease references, and each card is arranged in four items: recommended agent, application interval, maximum applications per season, and pre-harvest period, color-coded by safety level (short interval green, such as aphids 7 days; caution yellow, such as spider mites and powdery mildew 14 days; longer interval orange, such as scale insects and root rot 21 days). In practice, read the interval and count to build the spray calendar, then count back from the pre-harvest period to set the last application, and finally follow the operational notes at the card bottom (such as spider mites needing at least 2 consecutive applications alternating ovicides and miticides, and black spot disease being prevention first, starting before the rainy season).
map.安全采收期怎么执行，虫害没治完怎么办？: How strictly is the safe harvest period enforced if the pests are not yet controlled?
map.安全采收期指最后一次施药到采收之间必须间隔的天数（蚜虫药 7 天，介壳虫、根腐病: The safe harvest period is the minimum number of days that must pass between the last application and harvest (7 days for aphid products, 21 days for scale insects and root rot products, and so on). Even if the pests are not fully controlled, you must wait out the full interval before harvesting, and wash the produce thoroughly afterwards; if pests are still active close to harvest, switch to physical or biological control (yellow traps, insect netting, predatory mites, hand picking) rather than shortening the interval.
map.为什么要限制每季最多施药次数？: Why limit the maximum number of sprays per season?
map.连续使用同一作用机理的药剂会筛选出抗性种群，导致后期无药可用，这也是表中 2-4: Continuous use of the same mode of action selects resistant populations and leaves no effective product later, which is why the table caps applications at 2-4 per season. Once the cap is reached, rotate to a different mode of action (such as alternating ovicides and miticides for spider mites) or switch to cultural measures like orchard sanitation, pruning diseased leaves and improving ventilation; also stick to the recommended interval, since shortening it does not improve efficacy, it only accelerates resistance and raises residue risk.
